messages:
emma: pinging infra + eng. Peregrine POC sees TTFT tail spikes during auth load test. Median ~290ms but tail hits 2s-4.5s when ~150 parallel connections. They also see repeated mTLS handshake failures in their gateway logs. Demo Wed.

emma: snippet from their gateway:
```
2026-03-22T08:11:02Z mTLS: handshake failed (no client cert) from 10.66.1.12
2026-03-22T08:11:03Z upstream reset on /v1/generate id=pg-331 status=502
2026-03-22T08:11:03Z request_id=pg-331 latency=4120ms
```

rafael: thanks. two likely amplifiers: (1) connection churn from short-lived mTLS sessions + retries, (2) batching heuristics causing large batch_wait_ms when many short requests coincide. Also check if they're using HTTP/2 multiplexing vs multiple separate TLS connections.

priya: they said they front with an API gateway that terminates TLS and re-establishes mTLS with us. If their gateway opens new back-end connections per request, that will blow up our connection table and cause handshake timeouts.

dennis: first quick mitigations we can do while they change gateway config: a) enable route override to reduce batch_window_ms and cap max_batch_size, b) enable prefix_kv_cache with short TTL to reduce model-side cold penalties, c) extend our edge idle timeout + keepalive to hold connections longer.

emma: can you give exact commands we will run so I can share with customer audit?

dennis: will run this once approved:
```
redwood routes update --api-key=peregrine-poc-999 \
  --set batch_window_ms=3 \
  --set max_batch_size=14 \
  --set prefix_kv_cache.enabled=true \
  --set prefix_kv_cache.ttl=420 \
  --set edge.keepalive=120s \
  --set edge.idle_timeout=100s
```
I'll watch for 20m.

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T22:04:10 updated batching.short_seq_heuristic in cluster-global-1 by ci-bot. No rollback recorded.

rafael: good to note. the heuristic change could increase batch accumulation for many short seq requests, so route override makes sense.

priya: also suggest a small prefill (6 prompts) for their typical payment flows to warm the KV cache; solutions can prepare this. Prefill instructions: send 20 rapid seeded requests before demo start to prime cache.

emma: customer cannot rapidly change their gateway. They asked if Redwood can accept plain TLS (no mTLS) temporarily while they fix cert rotation. Any security concerns?

rafael: short-term we can allow TLS-only for that api_key in sandbox but need an approval ticket to security. For production we insist on mTLS. For POC demo we can enable TLS-only for 48 hours with audit logging. That will reduce handshake failures if the gateway is mishandling client certs.

emma: I logged ticket SEC-POC-482 and noted the temporary allowance. Security will sign off within a few hours.

dennis: applying overrides now and bumping edge keepalive.

infra-bot: config-change 2026-03-22T08:32:11 applied: route_override(peregrine-poc-999) batch_window_ms=3, max_batch_size=14, prefix_kv_cache.enabled=true ttl=420, edge.keepalive=120s, edge.idle_timeout=100s.

emma: customer flip: enabled keepalive on their gateway and allowed TLS-only for sandbox per our ticket. Running load test again. early results: median TTFT ~310ms, 95p down from 4.2s -> 720ms. still a few ~1.3s spikes but much better.

rafael: sample runtime trace I pulled:
```
req=pg-331 stage=queue wait_ms=580 batch_wait_ms=620 model=redwood-lite seq_len=20 batch_size=12 kv_cache_hit=false latency_total=1290ms
```
That shows remaining queue wait + a cold-kv miss. Prefill should remove those.

priya: solutions will send a 6-prompt prefill pack and instructions to run 25 quick seeded calls at T-15 before demo. Also offering a one-time demo burst option: 3 hours dedicated small pool for $350. If they want the week-long dedicated option, estimate ~$1,500.

emma: customer accepted 3-hour burst for demo peak and will run prefill. They also asked about whether SDK should switch to HTTP/2 multiplexing instead of many TLS connections.

dennis: yes, recommend HTTP/2 or persistent keepalive pools >=10. If gateway supports connection reuse/multiplexing that will help much more than fiddling with batch windows. Documenting as part of postmortem.

rafael: action items:
- dennis/rafael: monitor batch_size distribution and batch_wait_ms for 24h; consider rolling back short_seq_heuristic if regression increases POC noise
- priya/solutions: ship 6-prompt prefill + instructions to Peregrine
- emma: confirm demo burst purchase and security approval for TLS-only sandbox

emma: thanks team. will mark resolved after Wed demo completes. :white_check_mark:
